model.name: OtmuxBridge
model.description: Server-side read of the otmux/tmux session/window/pane tree for the Server Manager view (R31.3). Read-only: raw `tmux list-panes -a -F` (NOT the OOSH otmux wrapper — avoids server-ctx tty/classifier gates), parsed to sessions -> windows -> panes with pane_id (%N) as the stable attach target. Owner-gated via ServerManagerGuard. Design-ahead; intended impl src/ts/server/OtmuxBridge.ts. See design-server-manager.md.
